reviews_data.review_text:
What a beautiful location. It does not resemble any Caribou I’ve ever been to. It’s more like an independent coffee store. The space is huge. There’s lots of nooks and crannies and different type of furniture. There are floor to ceiling windows all over the store so the lighting is beautiful. There are tables for big groups. Tables for a couple of people. Couches.

I found the staff to be delightful. The manager is incredibly engaging. If you live in the area Or are passing by, check it out. Also, if you’re looking to drive a few minutes to a place that doesn’t look like every other coffee shop… Like a lot of Caribou or Starbucks… this would be a great destination.
Wonderful team at Caribou Waxhaw! Team members provide quick kind, excellent service. And...the coffee is amazing!
I really enjoy caribou coffee.   I've always been a Starbucks girlie, but I tried caribou and its actually better!  The staff is super friendly.
Great location, awesome customer service. My turtle mocha drink was delicious also my lumberjack sandwich was as well very moist bread tasteful.

We got our breakfast sandwich and waited for our coffees, but they seem to never come had to go up and see why they weren’t there and didn’t make them so we finished our sandwich and then got our coffee not ideal, but the coffee is always good!
Love this location. Very comfortable seating and the drinks are ALWAYS delicious!
Caribou is my favorite coffee shop and glad to see it near my location. Super nice and clean.
Nice friendly people and great service
Excellent Espresso!  Excellence Service.  High recommend!
Staff is VERY KIND! Yummy drinks! Definitely recommend the summer s'mores shaken espresso!!!
Virginia at the drive thru is so sweet and pretty! 10/10 blended coffee

Lots of seating areas. Great atmosphere. Staff was super friendly and helpful. This would be the perfect place to meet a friend or colleague, even to by yourself with plenty of space to spread out your work. Will definitely be back. P.s. loved the lemon cake, it's better than Starbucks!
reviews_data.owner_answer: We appreciate you sharing your positive experience. Hope to have you back soon!

reviews_data.review_text: Great location but the coffee was not good.  Went back the following week with same results.  Customer service is good but coffee is better purchased elsewhere

I do like the atmosphere okay however the location near southpark is the absolute best!

Dear Sharon,

Thank you so much for taking the time to share your feedback with us! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoy the atmosphere at our coffee shop. We strive to create a welcoming and enjoyable environment for all our guests, and your kind words truly mean a lot to us.

We look forward to serving you again soon and hope to continue being your favorite spot for coffee and relaxation.

Warm regards,
The Caribou Coffee Team

I went to newly opened store in Waxhaw, very excited due to past experiences with Chain. Staff were great and setup was warm and inviting. But ultimately I would go there for the food and coffee. I had a bagel, egg, cheese sandwich, previously my favorite and it was not good. The bagel was chewy and had a texture of being microwaved not toasted. The coffee was ok but not worth going back. I hope they change the procedures. In mean time plenty of local alternatives.

Follow up, Caribou reached out and gave me gift card. I went back and requested the bagel to be toasted. It was better, and I appreciate the follow up
